work.illustrationAlt: Three rising steps: a dashed prototype sketch, a Git-based pre-production build, and a secured production dashboard with a status table and RAG summary, all reading live from Jira.
work.title: From prototype to a production-ready executive dashboard
work.text: Leadership at a leading insurance comparison platform couldn't see project health, so teams built Google Sheets by hand to fill the gap. M20 took a Jira-connected executive dashboard from AI prototype to production. It passed IT and security review, stores no data, and was delivered within an existing support contract.
